brief:
Amnesty International released a report examining how women and girls have been affected by the conflict in Gaza, according to the human rights organization. The report, titled "No conditions for life: Women, girls and the gendered dimensions of Israel's genocide against Palestinians in Gaza," was launched on November 25, 2026, two years after the escalation of hostilities.

The organization convened participants from around the world for the report's launch, bringing together researchers and observers to discuss findings on the specific vulnerabilities and experiences of Palestinian women and girls throughout the conflict.

title: Amnesty documents gendered dimensions of Gaza conflict in new report
